$comment: Open data that scripts/data/build.ts downloads at build time. Later sources override earlier ones for the same DataSN, so the small live feeds (newer, with a page link for each question) come after the full dump. A source that is not required may fail without failing the build. Relative links inside answers are resolved against contentBaseUrl. The build stops if fewer than minimumEntries questions survive, so a truncated download never replaces a good site.
